items.name: cameroon-locations-core
items.title: Cameroon locations core
items.description: Copy-paste version of the cameroon-locations core: types, sources and attribution, name normalisation, lookups and search over the 10 regions, 58 divisions and 360 arrondissements, with the data inlined. No npm dependency.

items.name: location-picker
items.title: Location picker
items.description: Cascading region, division and arrondissement picker for Cameroon, with accent- and typo-tolerant search in French and English. Values are OCHA P-codes. Built on Popover and Command; data comes from the cameroon-locations-core item, so there is no npm dependency.

items.name: cameroon-map
items.title: Cameroon map
items.description: Map of Cameroon's regions, divisions or arrondissements on shadcn-map (react-leaflet): selection, tooltips, a sequential choropleth keyed by P-code and drill-down. Boundaries come from the cameroon-locations npm package and are credited in the attribution control.
